name: Nguyễn lords
events: Trịnh Cương becomes the new king of northern Vietnam (Đàng Ngoài) upon the death of his grandfather, Trịnh…
Lê Thuần Tông, Emperor of Đại Việt since 1732, dies at the age of 36 and is succeeded by Lê Ý Tông.
Nam tiến, the southward expansion of the territory of Vietnam into the Indochina Peninsula, is concluded.
